description: Bracket keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels (the keyboard/a11y half of Issue #22's proposal, supporting criterion 2). Make the bracket series cards focusable and navigable with arrow keys (move focus between series), with Enter opening the series detail page where available; add ARIA roles/labels so a screen reader announces each series (teams, status, score). Must not trap focus and must not break existing mouse interaction (Predict winner, Show/Hide games, View series detail links). Depends on FEAT-001 only for being on the same branch; the navigation logic itself is independent of theming.
steps: Review frontend/src/components/BracketView.tsx and SeriesCard.tsx and frontend/src/bracketLayout.ts (buildRoundColumns) to understand the DOM order of series. The bracket renders columns (rounds) each containing a series list; each SeriesCard is an <article> with data-series-id and an aria-label already (t('series.region', {high, low})).

Add a roving-tabindex keyboard navigation model to the bracket. Give the bracket grid an appropriate container role (e.g. role="grid" or role="list"/"group" with aria-label from t('bracket.region')) and make each series card keyboard-focusable: the card <article> gets tabIndex (0 for the active/roving item, -1 for the rest) and a ref so focus can be moved programmatically. Only ONE series is in the tab order at a time (roving tabindex) so Tab enters/exits the bracket cleanly without trapping focus.

Implement arrow-key handling on the series cards: ArrowUp/ArrowDown move focus within a round column (previous/next series); ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move focus to the adjacent round column (clamping to the nearest series index). Home/End optionally jump to first/last in the column. Use a flattened/indexed model derived from buildRoundColumns (e.g. a 2D [column][row] structure) so movement is deterministic. preventDefault on handled arrow keys so the page does not scroll instead. Do not interfere when focus is inside an inner control (let the toggle/predict button handle its own keys) — scope the arrow handler to the card container, not its interactive descendants, or ignore events whose target is an inner button/link.

Implement Enter/Space activation on a focused series card: if the series is final (has a detail route), navigate to `/season/:season/series/:seriesId` (use react-router's useNavigate or make the whole card wrap/trigger the existing Link target); for a predictable non-final series, Enter should select it for prediction (invoke the existing onSelect) to mirror the mouse affordance. Keep the existing explicit buttons/links working for mouse users (do not remove them). Ensure Enter on the card does not double-fire when focus is on an inner button.

Strengthen screen-reader labeling: ensure each series card's accessible name announces the two teams AND the status AND the series score (extend/augment the existing aria-label, e.g. add the localized status and best-of score, or add an aria-describedby pointing at the existing meta line). Add a localized instruction/label for the navigable region if helpful (e.g. aria-label on the grid). Add any needed new i18n keys to messages.ts (both EN and JA) for new SR-only text (keep additions minimal; reuse existing status/score strings where possible).

Preserve the existing 375px no-horizontal-overflow guarantee and mobile single-column layout — the keyboard model must not add width or change layout. Any focus-visible outline you add must be theme-aware (use a CSS variable / :focus-visible) and legible in both light and dark.

Add/extend unit (component) tests: a React Testing Library test for SeriesCard/BracketView keyboard behavior (frontend/src/components/BracketView.test.tsx or SeriesCard.test.tsx) covering: focusing a card and pressing ArrowDown moves focus to the next series; pressing Enter on a final series triggers navigation (assert via a mocked router / navigate spy) or on a predictable series calls onSelect; roving tabindex keeps exactly one card tabbable. Follow the existing frontend test patterns (render within MemoryRouter + I18nProvider; see SeriesCard.test.tsx and HomePage.test.tsx).

Add a Playwright e2e (frontend/e2e/keyboard.spec.ts) that loads the home bracket (offline seed), moves focus to a series via keyboard (Tab to the bracket then Arrow keys, or focus a known card), presses Enter on a FINAL series, and asserts the URL changes to the series detail route and the detail page renders. Mirror the offline/setup pattern in frontend/e2e/home.spec.ts and detail.spec.ts (use frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts).

Run `npm run build`, `npm test`, and `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend` from repo root (PATH prefix). Chromium is installed in FEAT-001. Confirm all green, including no regression in existing e2e specs.
acceptance_criteria: Each bracket series card is keyboard-focusable with a roving tabindex (exactly one card in the tab order at a time); Tab enters and leaves the bracket without trapping focus.
Arrow keys move focus between series (up/down within a round, left/right across rounds) and preventDefault page scroll on handled keys.
Enter on a focused FINAL series navigates to its detail route; Enter on a predictable non-final series selects it for prediction; existing mouse buttons/links still work.
Each series card's accessible name/description announces both teams, the status, and the series score (localized EN/JA).
A component test verifies arrow-key focus movement and Enter activation; a Playwright e2e (keyboard.spec.ts) tabs/arrows to a final series, presses Enter, and reaches the detail route.
No horizontal overflow at 375px and the mobile single-column layout are preserved; the focus-visible outline is theme-aware and legible in light and dark.

PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend  (keyboard.spec.ts reaches the detail route; existing e2e specs still pass)
findings: Implemented in commit 86935ec on feat/mlb-postseason-site. BracketView now owns a roving-tabindex model over the series cards built from buildRoundColumns (a [col][row] grid): exactly one card has tabIndex 0 (the rest -1), so Tab enters/leaves the bracket without trapping focus. Arrow handling lives on the card <article> via a bracket-provided onCardKeyDown callback (BracketView knows the 2D layout): ArrowUp/Down move within a column, ArrowLeft/Right across columns (clamped by row), Home/End jump to column ends; all handled keys preventDefault to stop page scroll, and focus is moved synchronously with el.focus() (works regardless of tabindex, so no requestAnimationFrame needed and jsdom tests are deterministic). The active cell is clamped against current grid dimensions so a season switch always leaves one card tabbable. SeriesCard gained tabIndex/cardRef/onCardKeyDown props plus a handleKeyDown that activates on Enter/Space: FINAL series navigate via react-router useNavigate to /season/:season/series/:seriesId, predictable non-final series call onSelect; events whose target is an inner control (target !== currentTarget) are ignored so inner buttons/links keep native behavior and the card never double-fires. Existing mouse Link/buttons are unchanged. Accessible name strengthened: new i18n key series.cardLabel announces both teams + localized status + best-of + score (replaces the plain series.region label on the card), and the grid wrapper is role=group with a localized bracket.gridLabel describing arrow/Enter usage (EN+JA added to the MessageKey union and both tables). Chose role=group over role=grid to avoid ARIA structural child-role requirements that would otherwise trip the FEAT-003 axe scan. Added a theme-aware :focus-visible outline driven by a new --focus-ring CSS variable (light #1d4ed8 / dark #93c5fd), with a slightly stronger ring on .series-card:focus-visible; mobile single-column layout and the 375px no-horizontal-overflow guarantee are untouched (home.spec mobile-overflow e2e still passes). Tests: new frontend/src/components/BracketView.test.tsx (7 tests: group label, roving tabindex count, ArrowDown within column, ArrowRight across columns, Enter navigate on final, Enter onSelect on predictable, inner-control no-double-fire via mocked useNavigate) and new frontend/e2e/keyboard.spec.ts (3 tests: roving tabindex count, Tab/ArrowRight to the FINAL ALCS then Enter reaches the detail route and renders it, ArrowDown clamp + SR aria-label asserts teams/status/score + localized grid instructions). Verification all green from repo root with the node PATH prefix: npm run build; npm test (frontend 85 incl. 7 new, infra 8, shared/backend suites); npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend (27 passed incl. 3 new, existing specs unregressed); npm run synth (cdk regression guard). Did NOT implement FEAT-003 (axe e2e + spec/docs). No push/PR performed per instructions.
